Subject: SIG asset request & scan cadence clarification

Grace / Redwood team,

Thanks again for taking the SIG intake call earlier today. For Acme Payments' upcoming SIG review we need a single consolidated vulnerability management snapshot that shows:
- scan cadence for the last 90 days (schedules + results summary)
- SLAs for CVE remediation by severity tier and any historical exceptions granted
- current open critical/high CVEs and ownership/ETA for fixes (or compensating control notes)

Two follow-ups from the auditor side: we typically accept a 30-day remediation SLO for criticals but Acme has requested a 45-day exception for a small set of infra components (third‑party DB connector). Please confirm whether Redwood can provide an exception letter and the expected mitigations during the exception window.

Deliverables needed by EOD Tue, 6 Jul: consolidated CSV of the last 90 days' scans and a signed carve-out letter if an exception is requested. If you need an alternate timeline, advise now.

Regards,
Claire Zhou
Senior Auditor | Blackstone Compliance Group

On Mon, Jul 5, 2027 at 11:12 AM Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com> wrote:
> I propose a short review on Mon 5 Jul at 11:00 PT to confirm the CSV format and the carve-out language...

Confirmed — meeting was productive. Notes / technical summary for the packet:
- Nightly scanner: internal yum/apt/image scans run between 02:00–03:00 PT; results pushed to our central findings store. Sampling rate for prod nodes is 100%.
- Weekly dependency scans run Sundays 03:30 PT; we include CVE crosswalk to NVD + vendor advisories.
- Current open items against Acme scope (summary):
  * CVE-2027-1987 (third‑party DB connector) — severity: high; mitigation: temporary traffic filtering + WAF rule; planned patch deploy 2027-08-12; owner: infra-db-team; ticket: INFRA-1189.
  * CVE-2027-2511 (image base package) — severity: critical; mitigation: container rollback + runtime guard; patch scheduled 2027-07-22; owner: platform-release; ticket: REL-4342.
  * CVE-2027-3004 (library X) — severity: medium; patch in next sprint 2027-07-14; owner: service-team-3; ticket: SVC3-209
- SLA mapping (for SIG packet) we propose: critical = 14 days, high = 45 days (with documented exception process), medium = 90 days. We will clearly mark the third‑party connector as a candidate for the 45‑day carve‑out and include compensating controls (filtering + increased telemetry).
Attachments included for the auditor: vm-evidence-index.csv (export of recent scans) and scan-schedule.ics (reusable calendar import for Acme). I also prepared a draft carve-out letter that Grace or Monica can sign and send back as a PDF via DocuSign.
- Internal ask: Monica, please surface the ticket exports and attach the DocuSign envelope when ready.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Applied Security | Redwood Inference
